Results.ReviewText: I grill one to three times a week when the weather allows.  I have owned many gas grills over the years. I have always admired the quality of Weber grills and when I decided to buy a new grill, I decided to purchase a Weber.  I am very impressed with the quality, value and performance of my Weber grill.  I would recommend a Weber grill to anyone that is planning to purchase a new gas grill.
Results.Title: Great Quality, Great Performance, Great Value

Results.ReviewText:
I enjoyed my previous Weber grill for 20+ years.
I am disappointed that this new one has only 2 wheels, not 4wheels like on my previous Weber; and now, being 20 years older, I SADLY have to lift it to move it.
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: Perfect for what I needed, first gas grill. Been a charcoal person my whole life and I'm 72. Really like the ease and convenience of using this grill.
Results.Title: First timer

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. Your satisfaction is very important to us. We are so sorry to hear you are not completely satisfied with the changes. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: It is a let down from the old Spirit Grills. You can tell there were many major cheap cuts. It seriously does NOT come close to the older version. I don't understand WHY companies always want to fix something that is not broken. Our last Spirit lasted us rt at 20 years. Grilling DAILY on it no matter the weather. Due to my husband is Diabetic. I don't think this one will last 3 yrs IF lucky! Had problems the entire first 2 weeks we bought it. Due to Weber Customer Service did not really understand what was going on was supposed to be normal come to find out. Very just disappointed. The grease pan needs replaced every week as it is so much smaller. Do NOT like the Open Cabinet at all when living in the Country especially. Every Animal finds a new home in it. That Flavorizer Bar in the back is useless except for something that will need replacing all the time. The actual 3 Flavorizer Bars for the grill are made THIN like the 1 and 2 hundred dollars no name brand grills. The way the grease catcher in the bottom is made, you constantly have to drag it out to clean it. From the back. And seems like a fire hazard the entire way it is designed. We don't use the sear thing. Kinda useless for us. And no way to grill over 3 steaks especially if large ones so forget about company. If just 2 people and not grilling an entire family pack of pork chops or chicken for left overs forget about it unless you want to grill 2 sets of meat. Those sides that left up & down are not stable enough to be constantly moving. Waiting on those to snap. And don't understand why the top is not full metal but some type of plastic. IF you plan on using it once in a while and not daily. Plus only 2 people it MIGHT be okay. We would have came out better rebuilding the old Spirit Propane Grill. And forget about lighting it with new setup they have. Each burner has its OWN lighting system. And IF you have wild animals every where, they are going to chew that up first.
Results.Title: Think about what & how you will use it before buy

Results.ReviewText: Good size for smaller decks (10’x12’ is mine) while still maintaining adequate cooking space. Heat retention is not an issue even on windy days, just remember to oil the cast iron grates before use and you’ll have a good grilling experience.
Results.Title: Good size and good looks

Results.ReviewText: Love my new grill - 2nd weber I have owned.  Especially like the coating on the side tables - much easier to clean than the shiny chrome ones on my old weber.
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: It was well packed, fairly easy assembly.  The unit is solidly built with some heft in the right places.  Grilling is even everywhere on the cook surface, which made slow cooking about 20 chicken legs easy.  No moving pieces away from hot spots like my old cheap grill.  I like the folding side tables which made for a small footprint on my limited space deck when not in use.  I found a cover which fits perfectly over the grill when folded (not from Weber, unfortunately).  Very happy with my purchase.  Oh, the sear zone is a must for steaks.
Results.Title: Weber quality on a budget.

Results.ReviewText: Works well once lit.  Not sure when it lit but it works great..  No regrets.
Results.Title: Love it.

Results.ReviewText:
Nice grill. lots of cooking area for a small grill. Cooks food evenly and really like the sear setting !
I have a tight area on my patio and this fits perfectly. Seems to be a quality made grill ! My first Weber grill.
Results.Title: First Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Unbeatable for the price. Solid, great looking, perfect for your best steaks with its seering zones.
Results.Title: Happy customer!

Results.ReviewText: LOVE this little grill!  Easy start. Plenty of grill space. Foldable side tables.  Pretty and perfect.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit

Results.ReviewText: Works Perfect. Starts up easy and the flare ups are minimal
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use but disappointed the back is not sealed like our old model
Results.Title: replacement grill

Results.ReviewText: Great BBQ! I assembled the unit myself, very easy to put together.  Nice even heat across the grill. I’ve had many different grills over the years but this one is by far superior! Had to buy the Weber cover because it didn’t come with one.
Results.Title: Great Grilling Experience

Results.ReviewText: I love my grill, it cooks great and is a solid piece of equipment.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Nice compact grill.  Can reach good grill temps of 600*f.  Grill flame tents are not as substantial as some other make of grill.
Results.Title: First Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Excellent heat control, love the sear zone. Size is perfect for a balcony or small yard and the fold down shelves add some needed space for holding food. Only niggle is that unlike grills with fixed shelves, there's nothing to grab on to when moving the grill.
Results.Title: Great heat control & size

Results.ReviewText: Great BBQ, perfect size for our patio, cooks food evenly.
Results.Title: Perfect BBQ

Results.ReviewText:
This is an extremely awesome BBQ. It is as advertised and easy to cook on. The sear zone works great. For a smaller BBQ there is plenty of grill space. I like that the sides go down giving me more room on my deck. For me it was pricey but I saved for a year so I could purchase it. Unfortunately as much as I  would like some of the extras they are not in my price range.
On another note the BBQ is very easy to keep clean. I slide the drip tray out every couple of BBQs and it cleans very easy along with the grill. My last BBQ was a weber and it was 30 years old. I expect this one will out live me! Highly recommend!
Results.Title: Best BBQ Ever!

Results.ReviewText: Just replaced a 15-yr old Genesis with a 3-burner Spirit and have to say, the smaller grill is perfect.  We will add a griddle 1/2 side insert. Love that the sides fold down and anxious to see what new things we can try.  We also have a Q2800 but wanted a bigger unit (without busting the bank)! BRAVO
Results.Title: Weber Decades of Great Grilling

Results.Title: Best grill ever

Results.ReviewText: Excellent quality, solid, great effective spark, valuable features, easy to clean.

Results.ReviewText: This is a perfect size. I like the way the bottom tray pulls out to clean it. Much easier to clean than the other Weber grills I owned. I’m very pleased with this grill.
Results.Title: Happy with this Weber

Results.Title: Much better quality than those from 10 years ago

Results.ReviewText: This is the perfect size for two people. It his used about 3-4 times a week , spring summer and fall. Best size for the two of us.
Results.Title: Great size

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this for the balcony of an apartment. It is no match for my natural gas Weber Genesis 335, but for at 1/3 the price I don't expect it to be. It does the job. Likes: It's a Weber, so it's well built and 
should last. Dislikes: piezo ignition rather than electronic. The piezo igniters will likely fail long before the electronic igniters on the Genesis 335. And the heat output from the 3 burners is nowhere near the capacity or equal distribution of the 3 burner natural gas Genesis.
Results.Title: A reasonable price for a budget Weber.

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber, a Spirit E350.  It is a great grill for a small family.  I did have a faulty hose/regulator upon purchase.  After several back and forth attempts with customer service I was able to get the issue resolved.  Today the grill works great and I love it.
Results.Title: Great Buy

Results.ReviewText: Great barbecue grill to replace the old grill they couldn't get the part for
Results.Title: Great barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Overall happy with this grill.  Cooks very well.  Heats up fast.  Only once, the burner went out and had to relight and it wasn't even that windy outside.
Results.Title: Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: I moved my old Weber that I purchased 28 years ago out to the hunting cabin.  I had replaced the flavour bars a couple of times but the original igniter still works.  It will likely outlast the cabin.  convinced my neighbour to buy a Weber and I bought one for my son's Wedding and he celebrates 21 years today.  Still loves it.  Also one for my daughter about 15 years ago.
Results.Title: Replaced a 28 year old Weber

Results.ReviewText: I work in the restaurant industry and work long hours. I do grill almost everyday with my Weber  Smokey Joe or on days off Performer Deluxe 22-Inch. I recently was working increasingly long hours and wanted to find a way to achieve a quick grilled meal when I got home and first thing I did was purchase this Weber Spirit. Just like the restaurant I work in I was able to achieve over 650 degrees in ten minutes with a nice hot blue flame and even sear cast iron grate. I love this grill and now use it daily with charcoal on days off. I own many cast iron pans and use them in this grill ranging from making bread pizzas stir fry u name it while also achieving great steaks burgers ect… this thing is a power house and highly recommend it. Don’t think twice just pick it up you won’t be let down
Results.Title: Restaurant Quality Results

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill to replace an existing larger grill that was starting to show it's age. I have a portable Weber grill that I use in my camper and wanted a smaller grill for the house. This grill is just perfect for the two of us. I am very impressed with how it cooks. The flame ups are non existent and the food comes out great on it. Wish I had bought one before.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Have owned previous Webers. New purchase not as well made.
Results.Title: Might not buy again

Results.ReviewText: We just purchased the this grill on June 5th 2025.  We ran into a problem from assembly.  One of the brackets is bent (obviously from manufacturing). I do not understand how it passed inspection.  Now the knobs for the burners are ridiculously out of function.  The first burner knob will not turn after ignition, can not control the heat.  The other two knobs are almost impossible to turn off, they keep getting stuck, I had a difficult time trying to turn the burners off.  So far, I am not the least bit impressed.
Results.Title: Great features if it works
